```sql
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m', oi.ordered_at) AS month,
  SUM(oi.product_price) AS revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_drink_item THEN oi.product_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.product_price), 0) AS drink_revenue_pct
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" oi
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', oi.ordered_at)
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 500;
```
